buildCommand: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; ROOT_DIR="$PWD"; if ! command -v flutter >/dev/null 2>&1; then FLUTTER_DIR="$ROOT_DIR/.vercel/flutter"; if [ ! -d "$FLUTTER_DIR" ]; then git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git -b stable --depth 1 "$FLUTTER_DIR"; fi; export PATH="$PATH:$FLUTTER_DIR/bin"; fi; cd visitarian_flutter; flutter pub get; flutter build web --release --base-href / --dart-define-from-file=dart-defines.json'
